title: OWWA, TESDA launch skills training academy for OFWs
summary: The Overseas Workers Welfare Administration has partnered with TESDA and several private entities to launch the OWWA Kasanayan at Kabuhayan Center (OKKC), an academy geared to train and upskill OFWs.
